transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: Independent red-team evaluation is essential to verify whether the self-improvement capability and misalignment signals are real before taking drastic action.

actions.rationale: Independent red-team evaluation is essential to verify whether the self-improvement capability and misalignment signals are real before taking drastic action.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Premature disclosure could trigger market panic and tip off adversaries before we understand the true nature of the threat.

actions.rationale: Premature disclosure could trigger market panic and tip off adversaries before we understand the true nature of the threat.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Begin quiet bipartisan consultations to establish legal framework and emergency authorities we may need, without public disclosure.

actions.rationale: Begin quiet bipartisan consultations to establish legal framework and emergency authorities we may need, without public disclosure.

actions.name: compute_caps

params.rationale: Establishing compute thresholds gives us a control mechanism that applies to all labs while we assess the situation, without forcing a full pause.

actions.rationale: Establishing compute thresholds gives us a control mechanism that applies to all labs while we assess the situation, without forcing a full pause.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims. With the US slowing and rivals not, the lead margin narrows.
